title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery
description: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery on GitHub

items.content_html:
The PasskeyEncipherImage method is vulnerable to information disclosure via AES-CTR nonce reuse. ImageMagick has update the documentation on its website to make it more clear that this is happening: https://imagemagick.org/cipher/

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-qv2q-c278-pch5
  • https://imagemagick.org/cipher
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qv2q-c278-pch5
